overloads.semanticRole: Inserts the string what before the character at position where in source, returning the resulting string (source itself is not modified).

constraints: If what is an empty string (""), the function returns source unchanged.
If where is greater than the length of source, what is appended to the end of source.
If where is less than one (1), what is inserted before source (i.e. at the start).
Differs from Change string: Insert string inserts characters without overwriting existing ones.
